steps.instruction: Write file skeleton. Imports: os, logging, re, datetime (date, timedelta), psycopg2, RealDictCursor, dotenv, engine.base. _get_conn() EXACTLY as mandatory_patterns. Class with all attributes. Methods have 'pass'. ASCII only.

Implement _detect_range(). Get today = date.today(). Lowercase the message. Check keywords: 'tomorrow' -> (today + 1 day, today + 1 day). 'this week' or 'week' -> (today, today + 7 days). 'next N days' using re.search(r'next\s+(\d+)\s*days?', msg) -> (today, today + N days). 'month' or 'this month' -> (today, today + 30 days). Default: (today, today) meaning just today. Return tuple of (start_date, end_date).

Implement _query_events(). Use _get_conn(). Query:

SELECT id, title, description, event_date, start_time, end_time, location, person
FROM calendar_events
WHERE is_active = true
  AND event_date >= %s AND event_date <= %s
ORDER BY event_date, start_time NULLS LAST

Params: (start_date, end_date). try/finally close.

Implement _format_results() and _build_summary(). Format: dict with id, title, event_date (ISO str), start_time (str 'HH:MM' or 'all day' if None), end_time (str or None), location (or None), person. Summary: if no events and range is just today: 'No events scheduled for today.' If no events and range is multiple days: 'No events in the next N days.' If events: group by date. For each date: 'DATE: title at TIME (location)' or 'DATE: title (all day)'. Keep summary concise -- max 5 events shown, then 'and N more'.

Implement execute(). Detect range from message. Query events. Format and summarize. Return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data={'events': formatted, 'count': len, 'start_date': str(start), 'end_date': str(end)}, summary=summary, confidence=0.95, sources=['mythos.calendar_events']). try/except/finally.
Review. _get_conn uses POSTGRES_HOST. Connections close. Summary never empty. Times formatted cleanly. ASCII only. Production-ready.
